title: Calculation set: percentages, margins, mark-up and ROCE (8 questions)
subject: Business
source: Written for business/y11 lesson 53 (Calculation set with answers (teacher-written, pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 53. All data is fictional. Show the formula and your working: 1 mark for the method, 1 for the answer with units (%).

questions.q: A shop's revenue rose from £64,000 to £80,000. Calculate the percentage change.
Revenue £150,000; cost of sales £90,000. Calculate the gross profit margin.
Revenue £150,000; net profit £12,000. Calculate the net profit margin.
A jacket costs £25 to buy and sells for £40. Calculate the mark-up.
Net profit £45,000; capital employed £300,000. Calculate the ROCE.
Net profit fell from £50,000 to £42,000. Calculate the percentage change.
Revenue is £200,000 and the gross profit margin is 35%. Calculate the gross profit.
A business sells 4,000 units at £12. Cost of sales £30,000; expenses £10,000. Calculate the net profit margin (1 d.p.).
A business has a gross profit margin of 40% but a net profit margin of 5%. What does this suggest?
questions.a: Expenses (overheads) are high compared with revenue; it should control overheads.
